Body Measurement Tracker

Keep a simple log of weight, waist, hips and chest. Records are stored only in this browser on this device.

Educational estimates only. Results are not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a treatment plan. Talk to a qualified healthcare professional about your health. Read the full medical disclaimer.

How your data is stored. Records stay in this browser on this device (localStorage). Nothing is uploaded to a server. Clearing browser data may erase them, so export a CSV backup if you want to keep them.

How to use this calculator

  1. Enter the date and your measurements, then press Add record.
  2. Use Edit or Delete in the records table to change entries.
  3. Pick a measurement to see it on the chart (two or more records needed).
  4. Press Export CSV regularly to keep a backup file.

The formulas

No formulas are used. Pounds and inches are converted to kg and cm for storage (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 in = 2.54 cm) and converted back for display.

Storage and privacy

Records live in your browser's localStorage on this device only. They do not sync between devices, may be lost if you clear site data or use private browsing, and are never sent to analytics or third parties. This tool does not interpret your numbers or give advice.

Want more detail? Read the guide: How to track weight and body measurements consistently.

Frequently asked questions

Where are my records stored?

In your browser's localStorage, on the device you are using. They are not uploaded anywhere.

Will I lose my data?

You can, if you clear browser data, use private mode, or switch browser or device. Export a CSV backup to be safe.

Can I use the records on my phone and laptop?

Not automatically. Each browser has its own records. Export a CSV to keep a copy.

Can I open the CSV in a spreadsheet?

Yes. The file opens in Excel, Google Sheets and similar programs. Values are in kg and cm.
